name: mailbox
description: Send and read direct 1:1 messages with another named agent (letters and replies), backed by an append-only shared thread file. Sends can be restricted by workspace config.collaboration.can_talk_to (see config/config.yml) — default is unrestricted if that config is absent.

reply_to.description: Optional id of the message this is replying to — keeps the reply attached to the original letter in the same thread (used with action='send').

wait.description: If true, block after sending until the recipient replies or 'timeout' seconds elapse. This polls the shared thread file for a reply — it is NOT live inter-process messaging, so it only works if the recipient agent actually runs and replies during the wait window. The letter is delivered either way. Used with action='send'.

timeout.description: Max seconds to wait for a reply when wait=true (also bounds this tool call's own execution time). Used with action='send'.

with.description: The other agent id in the thread to read (used with action='read'). Omit to read every thread I'm a party to.

limit.description: Max number of most-recent messages to return for action='read'.
